title: EOS venture migration state
description: Per-venture migration plan and state, produced by eos migrate plan and advanced by eos migrate apply. This build is read-only towards sibling repos: plans are committed reports only, and apply is exercised on fixture seeds alone.

pin_current.description: The EOS ref (tag or commit) the venture is pinned to before migration.

route.description: recompile rebuilds the seed from the venture's rulings; apply upgrades files in place; fresh-inception runs a new Session 0.

provenance_preserved.description: Artefacts carried verbatim through the migration: rulings, ADRs, logs, wargame arguments of record.

report_path.description: Repo-relative path of the committed human-readable migration report.
